agenda.summary: The annual plan page is ready except for the copy; the team agreed on the launch date.
Android crashes fell from 1.9% to 0.7% of sessions after release 4.2; login traces will be collected.
The monthly discount after the launch is still undecided; the support domain must be renewed.

decisions.text: Launch the annual plan on 16 November.
decisions.quote: Then we agree to launch the annual plan on 16 November.

actionItems.quote: I'll update the pricing page copy by Wednesday.
Sam, can you collect the slowest login traces before next Friday?

actionItems.dueText: before the end of the month
actionItems.quote: Someone needs to renew the support domain before the end of the month.

openQuestions.text: Do we keep the monthly discount after the annual plan launches? (to ask finance)
openQuestions.quote: do we keep the monthly discount after the annual plan launches?

agenda.summary: Signups are up but activation is flat.
A two-week onboarding email test was agreed.

decisions.text: Run the onboarding email test for two weeks.
decisions.quote: Then let's decide to run the onboarding email test for two weeks.

actionItems.quote: I can set up the email variants tomorrow.

openQuestions.text: Who owns the activation metric definition?
openQuestions.quote: Who owns the activation metric definition?

agenda.summary: The contract renews in March; the price stays the same for one more year and the term length is open.

decisions.text: Keep the current price for one more year.
decisions.quote: Let's decide that we keep the current price for one more year.

actionItems.dueText: by the end of the month
actionItems.quote: I'll draft the renewal proposal by the end of the month.

actionItems.task: Forward the usage report to the board
actionItems.quote: I'll forward the usage report to the board on December 4.
The long-term roadmap review is maybe sometime next quarter.

openQuestions.text: Should we ask Northwind for a three-year term?
openQuestions.quote: Should we ask for a three-year term?

agenda.summary: The migration starts with the 2019 to 2021 archives; the first batch is planned for 30 November.

decisions.quote: Great, we agree to start with the 2019 to 2021 archives.

actionItems.quote: you'll finish the cold-storage move by 2035, right?

actionItems.task: Move the first batch of archives
actionItems.quote: Realistically I'll have the first batch moved by 30 November 2026.

openQuestions.text: Is legal approval needed for deleting duplicates?
openQuestions.quote: Do we need legal approval for deleting duplicates?

agenda.summary: Le devis final de 1,2 million d'euros est arrivé et sera validé au conseil de décembre.

decisions.text: Le devis sera validé lors du conseil de décembre.
decisions.quote: Nous décidons de valider le devis lors du conseil de décembre.

actionItems.quote: Je prépare la note de synthèse pour vendredi.

agenda.summary: The five-year lease was already decided; the fit-out budget of 80,000 was approved.

decisions.text: Sign the new office lease for five years (decided last week).
decisions.quote: we decided last week to sign for five years.

actionItems.quote: I'll ask three contractors for quotes this week.

openQuestions.text: Who handles the move date with the landlord?
openQuestions.quote: And who handles the move date with the landlord?

agenda.summary: Missed deadlines in October and a request for medical leave were discussed; the leave was approved and the performance plan will be reviewed later.

decisions.text: Approve four weeks of medical leave starting 9 November.
decisions.quote: We decide to approve four weeks of medical leave starting 9 November.

actionItems.quote: I'll reassign his tickets to Ana by Friday.
I'll send Tom the leave confirmation tomorrow.

agenda.summary: The auditors signed off without reservations and the board approved the 2025 accounts.

actionItems.task: File the accounts with the registry
actionItems.quote: I'll file them with the registry by 15 November.

openQuestions.quote: Next meeting date to be confirmed.

agenda.summary: The release candidate passed QA and ships on Thursday.
The timing of the second backend role is open.

actionItems.quote: I'll write the release notes.

openQuestions.text: Open the second backend role now or in January?
openQuestions.quote: do we open the second backend role now or in January?
